page.notes: The first letter of the running head is a decorative capital; read as PROBLEMATVM, with the "P" not fully certain. The word "priorität" in line 4 of the list is a doubtful reading of "prioritate", as the scan is unclear there; "natura" is kept as printed. The Greek word in list item 7 is uncertain. The "568" at top right looks handwritten or stamped, not printed, so it is not transcribed as a page number. The "340" line and the "PP 3" signature are read from a small scan and may be imprecise.
